enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Adjust fan speed. Turn to left side. Lie still. Breathe regularly. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, butter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl, pan. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add butter. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for work and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Take out wallet and keys from drawer. Put wallet and keys in pocket. Put laptop and notebook in bag. Zip bag.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Step onto bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Type password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone call. Say 'Hello' to colleague. Talk to colleague. Attend meeting. Take notes. Type report. Print document. File documents. Organize desk. Check phone. Send text message. Update database.
Walk to lunch place. Order food. Pay cashier. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Wipe mouth. Stand up from table. Throw trash. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit as community program coordinator
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check emails. Write proposal. Make phone calls. Meet with partner. Update database. Print documents. File papers. Attend meeting. Take notes. Reply to messages. Organize files. Check calendar. Send email. Talk to supervisor.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus time. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Put headphones on. Listen to podcast. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Open cabinet. Take out pot, pan. Turn on stove. Place pot on stove. Add water. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Cook. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Serve in bowl. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up from table.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch show. Get up to get snack. Open cabinet. Take out chips. Open bag. Sit down. Eat chips. Turn off TV.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Log in. Open browser. Check social media. Play game. Type message. Watch video. Adjust chair. Stretch arms. Check phone. Send text. Turn off computer.
Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Shift position. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Turn to back. Adjust fan speed. Turn to left side. Lie still. Breathe regularly. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Open eyes briefly. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.
